decisions.rationale: First source MTHONG BA denotes true actual seeing in the realized-person set. It owns the first unquoted really did see, not the earlier quoted assertion.
First LA links the true assertion to its actual experience and owns the first about.
First bare MTHONG supplies the quoted true assertion. Keep it distinct from the preceding Tibetan actual seeing and later sensory labels.
The quotative is recast as the first say before the true quote. Its source grammatical function supports the depth6 correspondence; the mined glossary title does not.
First SOGS expands the first positive example into its other sensory cases, rendered the first and so on after the actual condition.
First BZHI counts the four positive true assertions. It owns the first four following realized person, not basic four or the repeated eight summary.
First source MA negates actual seeing in the negative true-assertion case. It owns unquoted didn’t after really; the second source MA owns the quote.
Second full MTHONG BA belongs to the negative actual condition and owns its unquoted see.
Second LA owns the second about, connecting the negative true assertion to its matching actual condition.
Second source MA supplies the quoted negative statement. Only the authorized n’t contraction is cut; did and pronouns remain outside.
Second bare MTHONG is inside the negative quote. Its English occurrence is earlier than the actual negative experience but belongs to this source assertion.
Second quotative ZHES owns the second say introducing the negative true claim. No new lexical say attestation is invented.
Second SOGS supplies the whole and such formula that completes the matching negative sensory cases.
Second BZHI counts the four negative true assertions, rendered four after the semicolon.
The complete PHAGS PA glossary directly attests realized person. Exclude a and the bound possessive relation.
These verbal conventions are named expressions in the local realized-person heading. Preserve the same reference/local-syntax basis and conflicting broader master senses as355.
The one explicit BRGYAD belongs to the realized-person heading. English regarding these two sets of eight repeats prior context and does not receive this same count twice.
GSUNGS directly attests mentions. This current source speech verb supplies the opening English predicate; Sutra is an inherited subject, not a new current MDO.
The next explicit MTHONG BA is the term being asked about, rendered seen in the first quoted something expression. Exclude something and quotation marks.
This THOS PA is the second quoted term in the question, not the final heard in the answer.
Third SOGS owns the whole and so on after the two quoted question terms. The intervening DANG is rendered by their list punctuation and remains unbanked.

The complete nominalized number BZHI PO supplies basic four, excluding basic and the article. Its mined one may ask gloss is mislocalized; the numeral reference and exact question structure support four, not an invented ask pair.
The complete interrogative/copular expression directly attests what it is. It is a grammatical phrase, not a dictionary-word promotion merely because the full expression is listed.

The complete if-it-is-asked quotation construction is rendered ask in the question frame. Reference material and the exact local question support this whole phrase; the mined correct perception gloss is unrelated.
MIG owns the eye in the first consciousness phrase, not a missing generic sensory faculty.
Explicit GI follows MIG and owns the local of before the eye. It is distinct from the bound genitive on RNA BA and later KYI on YID.
First answer RNAM PAR SHES PA is the eye-consciousness noun. It is not the later known term despite the identical source string.
Complete RNA BA directly attests ear; the bound genitive is not split off as a new particle.
Second answer cognition expression owns ear consciousness, with its independent source occurrence.
YID directly attests thought in the mental-faculty consciousness phrase, excluding the article.
Here KYI immediately links YID with its own explicit consciousness phrase and has a local unique of counterpart. This differs from the shared single genitive across the earlier354 verse.
Third answer cognition expression owns thought consciousness. The later extra consciousness after three kinds is a supplied noun for the remaining senses.
The last DANG in the consciousness list owns the explicit and before the remaining three; the two preceding list DANG forms only have comma punctuation and are omitted.
SNA directly attests nose in the parenthetic remaining-three list. The prose source explicitly names it; this is not a borrowed354 exponent.
LCE directly attests tongue, preserving its own position in the remaining-three list.
LUS directly attests body, not the body of an unrelated physical entity. Supplied and has no separate current source DANG between these three nouns.
GSUM supplies the three remaining senses. Other, kinds and the repeated consciousness noun remain outside.
The whole instrumental GYIS after GSUM owns the locally corresponding second by. First by before consciousness unfolds shared instrumental scope and stays unbanked.
The full experiential verb with BA directly attests experienced. No narrower word is forced inside the single English lexical word.
The complete relative-correlative/copular frame has exact glossary that which is. It is retained as a whole phrase at depth3, with capital That verbatim.

The whole according-to-order construction gives respectively. Both RIM PA and the complete formula have this glossary candidate, but overt BZHIN DU participates in the ordering construction; use the complete phrase rather than assign exclusive ownership to the shorter noun. No d7 member of a d3 phrase.
The final MTHONG BA labels the visual category in the answer, distinct from the quote and earlier actual experiences.
The final THOS PA labels the auditory category in the answer; it is not the earlier quoted question term.
Last cognition expression is the verbal known category in the final fourfold sequence, not any earlier noun consciousness.
The last explicit DANG joins known and sensed and owns and. Additional also remains unwrapped.
RTOGS PA is the fourth category, sensed, supported by the glossary and the explicit nose/tongue/body explanation.

The complete contiguous is-described-as classification predicate is recast as represents. Unlike the discontinuous earlier354 YIN TE and BSHAD, this full current construction can be selected together without crossing the ordering phrase. No exclusive BSHAD/represents word pair is claimed.
